/en/store/1957/about/.sample: 1957 – About – El Mercado de Origen Secure and transparent shopping Secure and transparent shopping Orders prepared with care Tel: 603 02 95 09 Skip to navigation Skip to content El Mercado de Origen Home Shop Journal Producers Contact Products search Login / Register image/svg+xml 0 Shop Home / Shop / 1957 / About 1957 1957 3 results Products About Shipping The story of 1957 begins in that very year, when Gregorio started out in the world of olive growing. Since then, olive oil has passed from one generation to the next, becoming a way of life now shared by three generations of the same family. That connection with the olive grove is also the starting point for their oils. To produce their extra virgin olive oils , they work with olives picked directly from the tree at their optimum stage of ripeness, aiming to ensure that the fruit reaches the mill in the best possible condition. From there begins a process in which every detail is designed to preserve the olive's natural qualities.
